description: Person Name Parser — Split full personal names into prefix, first, middle, last, suffix and nickname: name= (required; several separated by |, max 50). Handles 'Last, First' order, titles (Dr, Prof, Capt...), suffixes (Jr, III, PhD, Esq...), surname particles (van der, de la, al, bin), quoted or bracketed nicknames. Returns initials, formal/informal/sort display forms and a confidence. Offline, rule-based (Western name order). Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).

name.description: e.g. Dr. Maria del Carmen Lopez-Vega Jr.

name: util_name_parse
